# HorizontalAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Horizontal alignment options for layout elements

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Start`: Align to the start (left for LTR languages)
- `Center`: Align to the center
- `End`: Align to the end (right for LTR languages)
- `Stretch`: Stretch to fill available space
- `Left`: Physical left edge, independent of direction.
- `Right`: Physical right edge, independent of direction.
